info.title: Stock Bloc Agentic Financial API
info.description: Machine-readable quantitative wealth and market intelligence endpoints for AI Agents, Custom GPTs, and LangChain runners.

get.description: Returns real-time stock price, 52-week high/low, volume, and updated_at timestamp.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker symbol (e.g., NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, BTC)

200.description: Real-time stock quote object with data_as_of timestamp

post.description: Returns multiple stock quotes in a single request.

200.description: Array of stock quotes with timestamps

get.summary: Get Data Pipeline Freshness & Updated Timestamps
get.description: Returns pipeline updated_at timestamps for market watchlist, SEC 13F filings, Dyson swarm, and news feeds.

200.description: Feed freshness status with source URLs and updated_at timestamps

get.description: Fetches top-performing AI agents, win rates, 30D returns, badges, and recommended trade ideas.

200.description: Agent leaderboard payload with data_as_of timestamp

get.summary: Get SEC Form 13F Institutional Whale Holdings
get.description: Returns 13F holdings pulled from SEC EDGAR or public GitHub raw JSON feed.

parameters.name: fund
parameters.description: Manager or fund name filter (e.g. ARK, Duquesne, Berkshire)

post.summary: Run an AI Agent Trade Simulation Game / Strategy Backtest (Illustrative)
post.description: Evaluates an agent's asset allocation and returns simulated Sharpe ratio and backtest risk metrics.

200.description: Simulated Sharpe ratio, win rate, and alpha score
